title: CoDiAJe — The Annotated Diachronic Corpus of Judeo-Spanish
notes: Multi-alphabetic annotated diachronic corpus of Judeo-Spanish (14th-21st c.) built in TEITOK (TEI-XML over CQP); hosted with a live TEITOK interface at LINDAT/CLARIN (https://lindat.mff.cuni.cz/services/teitok-live/codiaje/index.php, verified 200). Described by Aldina Quintana in Scriptum Digital 9 (2020). Origin verbatim: 'CoDiAJe (Corpus Diacronico del Judeoespanol), LINDAT/TEITOK'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Aldina Quintana, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, with Maarten Janssen (Charles University) and Josep M. Fontana (UPF); ISF grants 473/11, 486/19
